project_type: TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo (turbo). Fastify 5 API (apps/api) + Prisma/PostgreSQL via Supabase (packages/db) + shared catalogues (packages/shared). Multi-tenant with Postgres RLS; access-and-correctness-critical (the exam analog of money-critical).
language: TypeScript (ESM, NodeNext; import specifiers use .js extensions)
build_system: npm workspaces + turbo at the root; per-package tsc. API build = prisma generate (schema at packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma) + tsc. Prisma client is generated from packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma.
test_framework: vitest. Fast/mocked suites run by default; live-DB suites (no vi.mock('@campusgate/db')) are split out via apps/api/vitest.live-db-suites.ts and run with the integration config.
build_command: npm run build -w @campusgate/api  (= prisma generate --schema=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc)
test_command: npm test -w @campusgate/api  (fast/mocked; MUST stay green, currently 454 pass / 46 files). Live-DB: npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api (each suite MUST pass IN ISOLATION).
verification_instructions: 1) After schema edits, run npm run build -w @campusgate/api (prisma generate + tsc). 2) Migration workflow from packages/db: npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma as a sanity check (the composite-vs-single-FK cosmetic diff is EXPECTED; confirm NO DROP on any existing table), then npx prisma migrate deploy, then npx prisma migrate status (must report up to date). NEVER prisma migrate dev. 3) npm test -w @campusgate/api must stay green at 454 + new fast tests. 4) npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api — each new live-DB suite passes in isolation. 5) 14 frozen migration dirs stay byte-untouched; no DROP on existing tables.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated by prisma generate (run as part of npm run build -w @campusgate/api); it is not committed source but the build regenerates it. No other generated/snapshot files are checked in for this task.
environment_constraints: Work directly on branch main; NO git worktree, NO push, NO deploy, NO Railway/webhook/Razorpay interaction. The live DB is a free-tier Supabase (session pooler <=15 clients, auto-pause, ap-south-1 latency): run live-DB suites one at a time / serially (the integration config already does), use the withRetry helper for transient P1001/max-clients errors, and never fire many concurrent connections. campass_app role stays NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS — never grant BYPASSRLS. .env files (apps/api/.env, packages/db/.env) carry DATABASE_URL (campass_app, RLS-subject) and DIRECT_URL (postgres, RLS-bypass, setup/teardown only) — do not print secret values.
contribution_requirements: No root AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md exists. House conventions (enforced by existing tests): every tenant table carries institutionId + @@unique([id, institutionId]) anchoring composite same-tenant FKs; composite FKs/partial uniques/RLS/triggers/CHECKs are RAW SQL in the hand-authored migration (Prisma models only declare single-PK relations + a comment block noting the raw SQL — the FeeStructure/FeeComponent precedent at schema.prisma ~line 2062). Migrations are hand-authored in the lettered a-j house style, NEVER prisma migrate dev. RLS policies use nullif(current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true), '') fail-closed. The catalogue-sync meta-test asserts EXACT set-equality between @campusgate/shared PERMISSION_KEYS/ROLE_PERMISSIONS and the union of the migration seed spans listed in SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS.
key_patterns: Routes (apps/api/src/routes/*.ts): one top-level app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate); per-route preHandler [requirePermission(key), requireModuleActive(gate)]; step-up routes use the VERBATIM fees ordering [requirePermission, requireStepUp, requireModuleActive] (fees.ts refund ~line 1122, adjust ~line 1059); every handler runs inside withTenant(institutionId, tx => ...) with institutionId from request.user (never body); Zod validates every input; audits via recordAuditEvent (keys validated against @campusgate/shared AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET). Marks-scope REUSES resolveMarkingFaculty(tx, institutionId, userId) + assertFacultyAssigned(tx, institutionId, facultyId, {classSectionId, subjectId, academicTermId, facultyId}) from apps/api/src/services/attendance-authz.ts VERBATIM (pass facultyId:'' sentinel to force the general assignment path). Allocation reuses the library lockStudent advisory-lock idiom: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${institutionId}:${scheduleId}, 0)) + count-under-lock + partial-unique backstop; seatNo is server-assigned integer ordinal stored as a decimal string (String(nextOrdinal)) — never lexical MAX over the TEXT column. Module gate key is 'examinations' (modules.ts is READ-ONLY this slice, deps unchanged); permission/audit KEY prefix stays exams.*. Status transitions via an advanceExamStatus(tx, examId, from, to) helper (optimistic where:{id,institutionId,status:from} + trigger backstop). ExcelJS export mirrors admin.ts (new ExcelJS.Workbook(), addWorksheet).
directory_structure: packages/db — Prisma schema + hand-authored migrations (14 frozen dirs; new dir 20261206000000_phase8_exams_slice1) + withTenant/prisma/privilegedPrisma in src/index.ts. packages/shared — permissions.ts (PERMISSIONS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS), audit-actions.ts (AUDIT_ACTIONS), modules.ts (MODULES + MODULE_DEPENDENCIES, READ-ONLY this slice). apps/api/src/routes — one file per domain (fees.ts, library.ts, admissions.ts, admin.ts, ...) registered in server.ts under /api/<domain>; add exams.ts at /api/exams. apps/api/src/services — authz-engine.ts (requirePermission/requireModuleActive), attendance-authz.ts (marks-scope helpers to reuse), audit.ts (recordAuditEvent); add exams/grading.ts. apps/api/src/middleware — auth.ts, step-up.ts (requireStepUp). apps/api/src/routes/__tests__ — fast mocked route tests + the live-DB tenant-escape suite + helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts. apps/api/src/services/__tests__ — catalogue-sync.test.ts (SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS). apps/api/vitest.live-db-suites.ts — LIVE_DB_SUITES glob list.
